column1: # Where each boss is, for the route plugins to walk to (October 2026): tiles measured in the game, the map on the boss's
# page of the OSRS Wiki, and the places the GPS plugin lists under the boss's name. The entrance, the lair or the last
# tile outside an instance: not a place to stand in the fight. A boss with no row has no way marked yet.
# A line with two more columns (label, note) is another place worth a route for that boss, under a button of its
# own on the boss's page: where the key to its lair drops, say. It is not the way to the boss.
# A line with four more columns (x, y, plane, note) is the way to a boss the route plugins (Shortest Path, GPS) cannot
# reach: the first tile is the last one they reach (the entrance, or the surface above), the second is where the boss
# is, and the note, shown under the button, says the rest of the way. When they can reach it, the second tile moves
# into the first place and the rest of the line goes.

column6: Moss giants of the Varrock Sewers, by her lair: 1 in 150 for a mossy key (1 in 75 on a moss giant task). A cannon can be set up there. One key opens the lair for good and is not used up by it; after that Bryophyta drops keys herself (1 in 16), and each key opens her chest once. Bring a knife or a slashing weapon for the web.
